title: Set a Table
prompt:
[Intro: funky rhythm guitar, four-on-the-floor kick, talkbox lick]

[Verse 1: cool male voice, rhythmic]
Bad news on the left, bad news on the right
Group chat's on fire, can't sleep at night
Everybody's shouting, everybody's sure
I'm just trying to make it to the door

[Pre-Chorus: building, falsetto]
Then right there in the middle of the mess
Somebody pulled a chair out, said, "Sit. Rest."

[Chorus: full disco groove, strings, falsetto stacks]
You set a table (ooh) in the middle of it all
Candles lit (ooh) with my back against the wall
Trouble at the window, trouble at the gate
You just smile and you fill my plate
My cup's running over on the floor
You set a table. I'm not scared anymore.

[Verse 2: voice lower, bass leading]
Old song by a shepherd boy, three thousand years
About a Shepherd walking with him through his fears
Then the Shepherd came himself, in sandals and dust
Set a table with his friends the night before the cross

[Pre-Chorus: building, falsetto]
Bread and a cup and "remember me"
And a seat with my name. I can't believe.

[Chorus: full disco groove, strings, falsetto stacks]
You set a table (ooh) in the middle of it all
Candles lit (ooh) with my back against the wall
Trouble at the window, trouble at the gate
You just smile and you fill my plate
My cup's running over on the floor
You set a table. I'm not scared anymore.

[Bridge: breakdown, bass and claps, chant]
Goodness (following me!)
Mercy (following me!)
All my days (following me!)
Jesus (leading me!)

[Final Chorus: everything in, horns on top]
You set a table (ooh) in the middle of it all
Candles lit (ooh) with my back against the wall
Trouble at the window, trouble at the gate
You just smile and you fill my plate
My cup's running over on the floor
Jesus set a table. I'm not scared anymore.

[Outro: guitar, glasses clinking, laughter]
